about: PoE2 Oracle next to other price checkers, and its own speed and size: every number the landing pages (site/index.html, site/ru/index.html) show about them, drawn by site/ui/bench.js. apps[]: each app the landing compares, with what was measured of it two ways. background: on 26 September, each app on its own a few minutes after launch, waiting for a price check with the game open behind it; states[] are the app's own states, each with processes (its process count) and memory (Task Manager's Memory column, the private working set, summed over its processes, in MB of 1024 x 1024 bytes). An app with several states is shown in the one of least memory, with the most beside it ('up to'), so each state's label reads after 'with'. play: on 27 September, real play, all four apps running while the PC's owner played, read in the same three minutes; minutes are CPU in % of one logical core in each minute, the landing showing how many times PoE2 Oracle's median minute each other app's median is, and label, where there is one, the app's state in those minutes. The landing lists PoE2 Oracle first and the others from the least memory to the most; its table rounds ratios to one decimal, its claims to whole times. facts: PoE2 Oracle's own times from its log, ready_s from launch to ready to price (26 September), panel_ms and listings_ms from the key press to the panel and to a search's listings, the fastest and slowest of the six checks the PC's owner made while playing (27 September), measured the days of those logs; and the installer's size in bytes. The performance page, docs/guide/src/{en,ru}/performance.md, repeats these in its tables and holds every other number, the method, the PC and the caveats; the opening paragraph of README.md and README.ru.md repeats some of them (39.6 MB, 0.27 s, 3.4 to 16.8 times the memory; 0.67 % against 3.23 to 4.23 % of a core while playing).
